lead_raw_text:
The structure of U4Cu2Ni2 (U2CuNi) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 8 atoms in the unit cell distributed over 4 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all three elements: Cu and Ni centers each have 12 geometric neighbors (6 Ni/Cu and 6 U), while U centers have 12 neighbors (4 Cu, 4 Ni, 4 U). The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Cu- and Ni-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing among like-centered Cu and Ni polyhedra.
